Description: Responsible for authenticating customers with username and password, maintaining authenticated sessions, terminating sessions on logout, rejecting invalid credentials, and providing access validation for protected checkout and order-consultation operations without unnecessarily exposing customer passwords.

Responsible for customer registration and profile management, including identification, contact and address data, account credentials coordination, language preference, favorite category, and customer personalization preferences used to provide category-based product lists and promotional content.

Responsible for organizing and exposing the pet-store catalog, including animal categories, products, item details, prices, category navigation, keyword search by product name, and category-based product information required by customer personalization.

Responsible for maintaining current item stock quantities and availability, identifying out-of-stock items as backordered, supplying up-to-date availability information at critical shopping points, and applying stock deductions when purchases are completed.

Responsible for the shopping-cart lifecycle, including adding and consolidating items, validating item existence and current availability, updating quantities, removing items, calculating item totals and cart subtotal automatically, exposing cart contents, and clearing the cart after a successful purchase.

Responsible for the checkout and order lifecycle, requiring authenticated access, initializing billing and shipping information from the customer profile, composing orders from cart contents, capturing supported payment-card information, handling alternate delivery addresses and explicit confirmation, generating unique order identifiers, recording complete order data and initial status, coordinating inventory deduction and cart clearing, and preserving customer-isolated order history and details for later consultation.
Communicate With: Authentication Service;Customer Account Service;Shopping Cart Service;Inventory Service
